description: List devices that could fit a scene opening, a shot or a join, best first, with reasons, missing details and when to use or avoid each. Candidates only: you choose; the plan is unchanged. No AI model runs. Input: plan (dpl.plan/1), exactly one of scene (id), shot (id) or join (two consecutive shot ids, a list or comma-separated text); optionally purpose (what the device should do). Output: dpl.device-suggestions/1. We don't keep the plan. We log a one-way fingerprint (hash) of it, its size, the tool, the type of client, the result and the time taken. Needs an agent key from a Shoot Plan account. Free, and it does not count toward the account's 3 free projects a month. Plans up to 8 MB and 120 calls a minute (5,000 a day).

join.description: Two consecutive shot ids (a name, a comma-separated list, or a list of names).

plan.description: The plan itself: a dpl.plan/1 JSON object (not text inside a string). Call shoot_plan_format for the schema links and an example.

name: shoot_plan_devices_suggest
